about: Paint the Town Red's bar-brawl rules, rebuilt on Minecraft's side. Numbers marked ptr: are read from the player's own copy per person; the rest are this mod's values, tuned so a Minecraft player plays it like PTR (a few punches put a biker down).

columns.number: The main number, with its unit
columns.source: Where the number comes from (ptr:<field> or mod)
columns.verified: Evidence from the in-game check, or 'no'

rows.rule: Before the fight, everyone stays where PTR placed them: standing, sitting at tables or behind the bar
rows.trigger: No brawl started in this world
rows.effect: Brawlers stand or sit still, turn their heads toward a nearby player, and ignore blocks being placed

rows.rule: The first hit starts the brawl for the whole bar
rows.trigger: A player hits a brawler, or a brawler is hurt by anything (arrow, lava, TNT, another brawler)
rows.effect: The hit brawler fights at once; every other brawler joins after a short random delay, closest first
rows.number: 0 to 3 s join delay, 48 blocks radius

rows.rule: In the fight, brawlers go for the player
rows.trigger: Brawl started and the brawler has no grudge
rows.effect: Chases and punches the nearest player in survival or adventure

rows.rule: Whoever hits a brawler becomes its target, even another brawler, which is how the bar fights itself
rows.trigger: A brawler is hurt by another living thing
rows.effect: It targets the attacker for a while, then goes back to the player

rows.rule: A brawler's swing hits whatever is in front of it, not only its target
rows.effect: Every living thing in the swing arc takes the punch

rows.rule: Fists hurt in a bar brawl: the Minecraft player's empty-hand hit lands like a PTR punch on a brawler
rows.trigger: A player hits a brawler with an empty hand
rows.effect: Deals the punch damage instead of Minecraft's 1 (weapons and tools keep Minecraft's damage)

rows.rule: A hit can knock a brawler down; it lies on the floor, then gets back up
rows.trigger: A brawler that canBeKnockedDown takes a hit and survives
rows.effect: Falls flat for its knockout time, can't attack, takes hits
rows.number: 20 % per hit, knockout time ptr:koTimeMin..koTimeMax seconds

rows.rule: After a knockout the brawler gets up and keeps fighting
rows.trigger: Knockout time over and still alive
rows.effect: Stands up over half a second and goes back to its target

rows.rule: Out of health means out of the fight: the body stays on the floor like in PTR
rows.effect: Lies flat where it fell with red paint around it, can't be targeted, despawns only when the brawl is reset

rows.rule: Paint the Town Red's red paint on every hit
rows.effect: Red dust particles burst from the hit point, more for bigger hits

rows.rule: The bar can be refilled for another brawl
rows.trigger: Command /bikerbar reset, or all brawlers down for 30 s
rows.effect: Removes bodies and brings every person back to their PTR spot, calm again
